item.tib: rgya so dar rtse gang bu nub phyogs dur khrod kyi gnas bdag dbang gi lha mo bdun gyi mchod thabs o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas mdzad pa
item.coloph: rgya so dar rtse gang bu dbang gi dur khrod la mo shel ri'i gnas bdag bka' skyongs dbang gi lha mo bdun 'khor mchod thabs bkra shis 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di yang / lcags khyi'i zla tshes nub phyogs dbang gi dur khrod g.yu mtsho phyug mo'i zhol rang 'byung rdo'i khang bu'i nang du/ snyigs dus kyi spangs khams mkha' spyod o rgyan byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis sbyar ba'o//
